rq: When gauge observations are replaced by global modelled discharge, how well can we assess developing high water, and can AI improve that assessment?

geoglows.timestamp: UTC interval START; shift +1h to common hour END
geoglows.release_delay: 5–12 days; hypothetical hydro-time replay, not as-issued operational forecasting
geoglows.area_field_units: TDX-Hydro USContArea/DSContArea m2; compare DSContArea / 1e6 at reach outlet
geoglows.version_policy: Reuse the pinned v1 acquisition receipts. Freeze selected hourly series and metadata hashes; global Zarr chunks are not mirrored.

clock: All hydrological inputs end by issue; publication delay explicitly not simulated. EO retains existing nominal past-only clock. Observed future Q is verification only.
population: All 481 held regional rainfall episodes x seven tributary targets x four offsets = 13,468 opportunities per stage; original bank slot indices preserved. Eys excluded as a target and predictor in both stages.
predictors: Nine active Q sources in both stages: seven tributary gauges and two Meuse context sites. Legacy slot 0 is always missing and excluded from source-derived features and normalization. Rainfall and observed verification are unchanged.
training: All correction arms use the same closed, outcome-valid earlier-year rows and validation folds. Raw/encoder missing inputs receive train-only imputation; unsupported satellite queries fall back to the causal hydrology-only policy. Raw/encoder selection may retain that exact hydrology policy.
calibration: Monthly empirical quantile mapping from paired valid historical hours before each annual boundary, annual fallback for <20 monthly pairs, positive multiplicative upper tail. Observed stage calibration is identity.
selection: Annual earlier-year validation over the complete verification-eligible rainfall census, not future high-water labels. Identical training/validation opportunities across hydrology/raw/encoder arms. Raw selection may retain the causal hydrology-only policy; zero encoder influence retains the exact selected raw policy without a separate EO-free retuning search. Unsupported raw inputs fall back to hydrology; unsupported encoder inputs fall back to raw.
primary: Site-balanced next-24h MAE in mm/h in the seven-target high-water stratum. Also report the complete rainfall census with fallback and the joint high-water/EO-supported stratum. Native m3/s per site retained.
scope: Stages 1–2 only. No new imagery extraction, fine-tuning, TTM re-encoding, AlphaEarth sweep or external rivers by default.
source_comparison: Same seven targets and nine active Q channels in both stages. No Eys coverage experiment.
uncertainty: Shared 999 whole-year draws with fixed site population in each verification-eligible declared stratum. Any draw missing a required site is undefined and counted, including partially missing populations.
